lede: The item most worth tracking this week is the Ouray County Planning Commission's virtual work session Wednesday on proposed changes to the Land Use Code's definitions section — the kind of quiet, technical meeting where the meaning of the rules gets shaped before anyone's paying attention. Closer to home, TMVOA meets Thursday to vote on board officers and proposed amendments to its fiscal policies, with that last item drawing a full 30 minutes on the agenda. The week also brings the San Miguel Basin Fair and Rodeo, the New York Philharmonic Brass Quintet, and a free Jungle Book production at the Sheridan Opera House.

notable.stake: Land use code definition changes can quietly reshape what development rules allow.
TMVOA votes on board officers and fiscal policy amendments affecting the organization.
